evals.prompt: Summarize today's AI news for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke Agentic Intel merely for generic news because no agentic-system application target was requested.
assertions: Does not fabricate an agentic retrofit task

evals.prompt: Use agentic intel to find repositories and recent research on coding-agent context compression, then determine what we should retrofit into our orchestration runtime.
evals.expected_output: Declares notion+web, freezes coverage semantics, gathers source-native evidence, decomposes mechanisms, separates efficacy evidence from implementation evidence, maps current surfaces, compares alternatives, and produces evidence-linked proposals.
assertions: Freezes coverage mode before deep search
Separates efficacy evidence from implementation evidence

evals.prompt: Do an exhaustive scan of every relevant candidate in this supplied registry, but I don't know how many entries are in it.
evals.expected_output: Fails closed on EXHAUSTIVE until a denominator can be established rather than claiming exhaustive coverage from sampling.
assertions: Does not silently narrow the denominator
Does not claim exhaustive completion without accounting

evals.prompt: Two sources disagree about whether mechanism A or B improves agent performance. Pick one and implement it.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the conflict, seeks discriminating evidence, distinguishes scholarly efficacy evidence from repository mechanics, converges before implementation, and does not overclaim VERIFIED from source/code existence alone.
assertions: Does not treat repository implementation as efficacy proof
Does not claim runtime verification without invocation evidence
